name: gpu_attested_identity_window
description: Checks whether each contract GPU identity, resolved through an operator-supplied identity bridge to an NVIDIA device UEID, produced a fresh nonce-bound attestation during the contract window. This claim covers attested identity and freshness only; it does not cover delivered capacity, utilization, or performance.

claim.text: Each GPU identity bridged from the contract schedule produced a fresh, nonce-bound NVIDIA attestation during the contract window.

gpu_attestation.attestation_nonce.probe: import nvattest EAT claims with ./import_nvattest so the EAT nonce from the token is stored, not the challenge nonce
gpu_attestation.attestation_nonce.why: If the challenge nonce is copied into the attestation artifact, the freshness comparison becomes circular and replay cannot be detected.

identity_bridge.mappings.probe: export the provider asset register entry that maps each contract GPU ID to the device UEID, with mapping_source, mapping_time, and mapper
identity_bridge.mappings.why: A UEID is a device-cert-derived identifier, not a board serial or schedule ID. Without the bridge, attestation evidence cannot be resolved to the contract identity and the claim stays UNKNOWN.

probe_manifest.declared_gpu_ids.probe: commit the contract GPU IDs this attestation run is declared to cover into the probe manifest before running nvattest
probe_manifest.declared_gpu_ids.why: Without pre-declared GPU IDs, the receipt cannot say which contract identities the attestation was supposed to cover.
